verdict.rationale: The evidence lists no local git command; the documented local builtins are only cat, grep, ls, cp and similar. Committing and pushing is still achievable indirectly, by running git over SSH/Mosh on a remote machine or inside the VS Code for web / GitHub Codespaces / GitPod sessions Blink connects to, with SSH key support for authentication. So the work happens on a remote host rather than directly on the device. Missing for 10: evidence of a local git client on the device, documented commit/push workflow, any independent or hands-on corroboration of git usage.
